limits_note: write-gated: registration is open (email + password form renders 200) but unauth organization_create returns 'У доступі відмовлено'. A 300-dataset sample contained ZERO datasets with an empty owner_org — every record belongs to a ministry, state enterprise or register authority. That is the structural proof that this is a publishers-only catalog.
reliability_note: operational through wartime; stable API. Same consumer-vs-publisher split as every other national CKAN.

evidence.proved: 300 sampled, 0 with empty owner_org, 124 distinct organisations (Національна поліція України, ДП «СЕТАМ», etc.)
